The '''Battle of Heg''' was fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Heg]] during the [[Subjugation of Bundim|Imperial subjugation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bundim]]. The Imperial forces decimated the Rebel presence in the city, and Heg was levelled by [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] fire and bombings lasting three [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="RtB" />
